meta.title: Privacy — Trebbol
meta.description: At Trebbol, it’s important to us that you have choices and control in how we handle your personal data.

hero.title: Privacy at Trebbol
hero.subtitle: At Trebbol, it’s important to us that you have choices and control in how we handle your personal data. All our products are reviewed extensively by our privacy team before launch, so you can expect privacy by design.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.text: Your personal data belongs to you, and you have the right to understand and control how it’s used.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.text: If you want to exercise your rights over your personal data, you can contact us any time at <email>privacy@trebbol.com</email>.

keepingInLoop.title: Keeping you in the loop
keepingInLoop.text: If you share data with us, we’ll let you know exactly how we’re using it. We’ll explain how we collect and use your personal data in our privacy notices, so you know what’s happening.

rightToChoose.title: Giving you the right to choose
rightToChoose.text: We give you clear choices and simple tools to exercise your rights. If we collect data, we’ll tell you why. Adjust your preferences anytime through the ‘Security & privacy’ section in-app.

protectingData.title: Protecting your data
protectingData.text: Our full-stack security systems watch over your account 24/7 to flag suspicious activity and keep your details safe. Our support team is always on hand if you need help.

customersFirst.title: Putting our customers first
customersFirst.text: When we collect and use your data, it’s only to help us deliver exceptional services and improve your experience.

notices.title: Our full privacy notices
notices.card1: Customer Privacy Notice for personal account users

closing.line1: We want to build a better digital ecosystem with you in control, and respecting your privacy is a big part of that goal.
closing.line2: We’re always working to improve, so if you notice something that doesn’t meet your expectations when it comes to privacy, let us know.
closing.line3: Our friendly privacy team at <email>privacy@trebbol.com</email> will make sure your voice is heard.
